tool_args.rationale: The pilot already matches the target horizon of 0.8, but s_grad reaches only 2.44, below the candidate onset range of 2.50–2.68. A high-gradient probe is the lowest-cost targeted way to test whether the flattening persists or gives way to an avalanche drop.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All five observations are below the proposed threshold range, so neither the threshold nor the avalanche strength can be estimated.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a Haldane or Cobb–Douglas law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot increases u_now and s_grad together, so its flattening cannot distinguish substrate inhibition or smooth saturation from a baseline that precedes a threshold-driven drop.
It costs more, and finer trajectory sampling does not directly target the unresolved high-gradient regime.
It does not test the sink-gradient threshold.
